name: 49. Gemini Server-Side Tool Invocations + thoughtSignature Fidelity (PR #6071)
description:
PR #6071 (server-side tool call support) with PR #6065/#6066 (tool combination).

When toolConfig.includeServerSideToolInvocations is enabled, Gemini reports built-in tools it ran
itself as toolCall/toolResponse part pairs instead of the older text + groundingMetadata shape.
Before PR #6071 those parts were silently dropped: the response still returned 200 with plausible
text, so no status assertion can pin this — the parts themselves have to be inspected. The
thoughtSignature bytes riding on those parts matter independently: Gemini rejects a follow-up turn
that replays the assistant content without them.

The /genai surface reaches Gemini three different ways, which are three different code paths:
  - bare model name (gemini-3.6-flash)      -> Gemini converter path
  - vertex/ prefix (vertex/gemini-2.5-flash) -> Vertex converter path (never passes through)
  - gemini/ prefix (gemini/gemini-3.6-flash) -> raw body passthrough (explicitGemini, genai.go)
All three are covered here, streaming and non-streaming, because they share no conversion code.

Cases:
  1/2. Gemini converter, non-streaming and SSE: toolCall/toolResponse parts survive, stay id-paired,
       and keep thoughtSignature.
  3/4. Vertex converter on a PRE-Gemini-3 model (2.5), non-streaming and SSE: tool combination did
       not exist before Gemini 3, and Vertex rejects the mix outright with 400 "Multiple tools are
       supported only when they are all search tools". Bifrost must therefore still drop googleSearch
       and keep the declarations there, so a 2xx with a functionCall is the pin.
  5/6. Vertex converter on Gemini 3.6, non-streaming and SSE: the same request keeps BOTH tool kinds,
       which is what PR #6066 set out to allow. Together with 3/4 this pins the version boundary in
       both directions -- the original PR #6066 gate keyed on provider alone and 400d every 2.5 call.
       These two are [PREVIEW]-tagged: gemini-3.6-flash is not published to every Vertex project/region
       (it 404s as "Publisher model ... was not found or your project does not have access to it"), so a
       default run pins only the 3/4 direction. Run with INCLUDE_PREVIEW=1 on a project that has the
       model to close the boundary.
  7.   Gemini raw passthrough: the same parts survive the non-converting path byte-for-byte.
  8.   Multi-turn replay: the assistant turn captured in case 1 is sent back in contents. Gemini
       validates thoughtSignature server-side, so a 2xx here proves the signatures round-tripped
       intact. Skips itself if case 1 captured nothing.
